version.changelog: Clearer data layout: what to read, what to save, and where

llm.summary: This is a disclosed local-memory skill that stores and manages markdown files on the user's machine, with privacy caveats but no evidence of hidden exfiltration or malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: Filesystem reads, writes, grep, mv, and optional git or cloud-folder workflows are scoped to the memory store and are proportionate for a local durable-memory tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown/json guidance with no executable files, no required binaries, and no dependency or remote payload mechanism found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad memory triggers and proactive recall cues, but they are disclosed, tied to durable-memory behavior, and constrained by rules against secrets, sensitive third-party data, and unnecessary reads.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates persistent plaintext files and can move or delete memory entries during maintenance, migration, and privacy workflows; default deletion policy is confirm and the artifacts disclose plaintext storage and deletion limits.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: remember, recall, organize, update, and delete durable facts in a local markdown store at ~/Clawic/data/memory/.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to keep durable local memory in plaintext files under ~/Clawic/data/memory/. Do not store secrets there, review excluded topics and deletion policy, and use private encrypted or version-controlled storage carefully because cloud sync and git history can retain deleted facts.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad save/remember style triggers and proactive lookup cues are expected for a memory skill; artifact rules limit use to durable facts, named entities, and explicit recall/update/delete situations rather than unrelated behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: File creation, archive moves, migration writes, renames, and deletion of wrong facts are expected store-management operations; several warnings could be more prominent, but the artifacts disclose the local path, plaintext nature, default confirmation policy, and deletion receipts.
[SSD-3] expected: Persisting stated preferences without an upfront questionnaire is purpose-aligned for this skill, and the broader artifacts provide user controls such as excluded_topics, capture threshold, privacy posture, and secret refusal.
